Additional public qualitative palettes in `palettes.tsv`:
- Okabe-Ito (2002): Masataka Okabe & Kei Ito, "Color Universal Design (CUD)"
  (public scientific colorblind-safe swatch specification).
- Tableau 10 / Classic Tableau: Publicly published Tableau categorical color palettes.
